title: Action Star: NYC Siege 3D
pitch: Infiltrate a skyscraper in New York City, combining shooting, melee combat, and cinematic stunts to defeat enemies and escape in record time.
core_loop: Navigate through levels, engage in combat using shooting and melee skills, utilize Bullet Time for strategic advantage, and complete objectives to progress.
mechanics: Third-person perspective with dynamic camera angles.
Shooting mechanics with aim assist and recoil control.
Melee combat with combos and finishers.
Bullet Time ability to slow down time for dodging and executing stunts.
Health system with regeneration over time or through pickups.
Stealth elements to avoid detection by enemies.
scoring_system: Final Take Rating = Base Time Bonus + Stunt Score. Base Time Bonus: Points awarded for time remaining under the stage time cap. Stunt Matrix: Bullet Dodge +50, Slide & Shoot +100, Air Takedown +150, Wall-Run Kill +200. Multi-Kill Combo: 3 kills within 2 seconds earns a multiplier from x2 up to x5. Combo/diversity rule: each unique stunt action raises the combo multiplier by +0.5, capped at 5.0; points added = base points x current multiplier; combo resets when the player takes a hit. Ranks: S (1000+), A (800-999), B (600-799), C (400-599), F (<400).
physics_rules: Bullet Time slows time to 0.3x normal speed. Energy drains at 10% per second while active, recharges at 5% per second when inactive. Cooldown of 5 seconds after deactivation. Gravity affects all objects and characters, with realistic physics for falling and thrown objects.
controls: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming, left click to shoot, right click for melee, spacebar to jump, shift to sprint, Q to activate Bullet Time, E for interactions, R to reload, C to crouch.
win_conditions: Reach the exit of the level within the time limit.
lose_conditions: Player's health reaches zero or player is detected by security systems.
levels: Floor 1: Lobby - Initial enemy encounter, tutorial on basic controls.
Floor 2: Offices - Stealth section with patrolling guards.
Floor 3: Security Room - Disable security systems to proceed.
Floor 4: Executive Suites - Intense combat with elite enemies.
Floor 5: Rooftop - Final showdown and escape via helicopter.
art_sound_direction: Realistic 3D environments with high-detail textures. Dynamic lighting and shadow effects. Intense and cinematic soundtrack with action-oriented sound effects. Voice acting for main character and key enemies.
